summary: Tested E2E Encryption features and Chat Double Message Fix for MeetFlow. All backend API tests pass (17/17). Frontend E2E encryption features working correctly - banner, lock icons, encryption toggle, all chat controls present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: E2E encryption fully implemented and working. Key endpoints: POST /api/chat/keys (store public key), GET /api/chat/keys/{user_id} (retrieve public key), PUT /api/chat/conversations/{conv_id}/encryption (toggle E2E), POST/GET /api/chat/conversations/{conv_id}/group-key (group key storage). Messages with e2e_encrypted=true show 'Verschluesselte Nachricht' in last_message preview. Frontend shows E2E banner (data-testid='e2e-banner') and lock icons on encrypted messages. WebSocket double message fix implemented in websocket.py line 23 using exclude=user_id.

backend_api_tests: POST /api/chat/keys - requires public_key field (400 on empty) ✓
GET /api/chat/conversations/{conv_id}/group-key - returns null when not set ✓
Encrypted messages show 'Verschluesselte Nachricht' in last_message preview ✓
POST /api/chat/conversations - create group with encrypted field ✓
GET /api/chat/conversations/{conv_id}/messages - retrieve messages with e2e_encrypted field ✓
frontend_tests: Chat page loads with conversation list (data-testid='chat-conv-list') ✓
E2E encryption banner visible when conversation is encrypted (data-testid='e2e-banner') ✓
Encryption toggle works - switches between encrypted/not encrypted ✓
Toast notification shows 'Verschluesselung deaktiviert' when toggling off ✓
System message shows 'Ende-zu-Ende-Verschluesselung deaktiviert' in chat ✓
Lock icons visible on encrypted messages (5 found) ✓
Chat input and send button work (data-testid='chat-input', 'chat-send-btn') ✓

e2e_key_registration.store_public_key: POST /api/chat/keys stores JWK public key for authenticated user

e2e_message_encryption.encrypted_flag: Messages can be sent with e2e_encrypted=true flag
e2e_message_encryption.last_message_preview: Encrypted messages show 'Verschluesselte Nachricht' in conversation list
e2e_message_encryption.lock_icons: Lock icons appear next to timestamps for encrypted messages

e2e_toggle.system_message: System message posted when encryption state changes

frontend_e2e_banner.banner_visible: data-testid='e2e-banner' shows when conversation is encrypted

websocket_double_message_fix.ws_manager: broadcast() method accepts exclude parameter to skip sender
websocket_double_message_fix.note: Fix is for MEETING WebSocket (/api/ws/{meeting_id}/{user_id}), not chat WebSocket

websocket_fix.change: Changed from broadcast(data) to broadcast(data, exclude=user_id)
websocket_fix.purpose: Prevents sender from receiving their own chat message back via WebSocket (prevents duplicates)

features: Group key support for group chats

mocked_apis.none: All APIs are real, no mocking
